:::{.callout-learning}
After completing this session, you will be able to:

-   Practice joining tables together
-   Practice identifying primary and foreign keys
-   Practice using common cleaning and wrangling functions
:::

## Overview

In this practice session you will work with bird survey data from the central Arizona-Phoenix metropolitan area.  In Exercise 1 you will practice joining tables with `left_join()`, `full_join()`, and `inner_join()`.  In Exercise 2 you will practice wrangling and joining the data, including cleaning up inconsistent values, and then save your work with the Git and GitHub workflow.
